the design and implementation of the following: (i) a cell monitoring system that is capable of continuous cell voltage and temperature monitoring; (ii) an isolated communication interface between the cell monitoring system and a battery management system; (iii) a non-volatile data storage system that can store cell parameters for later retrieval.

the development of an intelligent gauge for a hierarchical Battery Management System.

we developed an intelligent gauge for a battery cell that can communicate with the battery management system and also store the data in a non-volative memory.

we have designed a smart cell gauge for a battery management system, that is able to monitor the cell parameters, and store the cell history in a non-volative memory, so that the cell can be reused in a second life battery.
